grouping: Reviewed three rule categories (17 occurrences). None has fixGroupId. Repeated generated HTML wrapper pattern reviewed with each concrete template implementation.
recipeFetch: All fetched with curl -fsSL and Cache-Control:no-cache / Pragma:no-cache; validation, exceptions and fix recipes read before assessment.
result: No confirmed defects at these occurrences; no source, dependencies, generated bundles or lint configuration changed. No suppression added.

humanImpact.insecure-crypto-risk: Predictable credentials would allow impersonation. These occurrences generate non-secret UI, sorting, timing and telemetry values, so no authentication weakness was established.
humanImpact.postmessage-origin-risk: Untrusted window messages could trigger actions in the app. This occurrence receives worker highlighting jobs, not messages from arbitrary browser windows.
humanImpact.dangerous-html-sink: Unescaped HTML could execute attacker code in the visitor origin. These concrete template paths already escape or restrict dynamic data; hostile-input tests found no injected tags or event attributes.

reviews.evidence: source-map quick-sort chooses a random pivot. This affects sorting, not a credential.
Prism markdown autoloader generates a DOM element ID to find code blocks after language loading.

Prism registers this handler only in the !self.document worker branch; reads highlighting jobs and posts highlighted code. The canonical same-application Worker exception applies. No cross-window listener at this occurrence.
react-rewards createRng seeds visual particle animation randomness.
HLS uuid fallback generates player-instance and CMCD media telemetry session IDs; these are not authentication sessions.
React DOM randomKey names internal element properties (__reactFiber, __reactProps, etc.).
nanoid/non-secure is called by PostCSS Input to label anonymous CSS input for diagnostics (<input css ...>).
Dash bundled uuid function is exported by its utility module and called for CMCD reporter sid telemetry; not DRM authentication credentials.
Storybook React Aria SSR context generates a prefix for component DOM IDs.
Ky calculateDelay randomizes HTTP retry timing (jitter).
Swiper generates a wrapper DOM ID used for accessibility relationships.
ce-la-react SSR wrapper calls Dash getTemplateHTML, which removes src and delegates to custom-media-element. Its serializer allowlists media attribute names and escapes values.

ce-la-react SSR wrapper calls HLS getTemplateHTML. Configuration JSON replaces less-than signs with Unicode escapes, preventing script closing-tag injection. Media attributes use custom-media-element allowlist and escaping.
Mux UUID fallback supplies viewer, analytics session, player-instance and view IDs. Uses Web Crypto when available; fallback identifiers do not authorize playback.
SSR template delegates to Spotify getTemplateHTML. Fixed-origin embed URL uses constrained path captures and URLSearchParams; serializeAttributes escapes names and values.

SSR template delegates to YouTube getTemplateHTML. Embed origin is fixed to YouTube/YouTube-nocookie; URLSearchParams serializes configuration and serializeAttributes escapes names and values, including JSON data-config.
Storybook channel assigns a sender identifier placed in outgoing event.from; identifier labels message source, not a secret token.

validation.templateMethod: Executed exact function bodies from reported source maps using Node VM, parsed resulting HTML with happy-dom. Four hostile quote/closing-tag/entity payloads against Dash/HLS/Spotify/YouTube. Asserted no injected img, no on* attributes, no executable script, fixed iframe origins and intact HLS JSON.
validation.templateLimit: Focused serializer tests, not a complete browser playback or dependency security audit.
validation.sourceMaps: Maps have coarse mappings in some bundles; used literal match context and sourcesContent/callers rather than treating approximate source positions as precise.
validation.comparison: All 46 diagnostic identities unchanged; 17 reviewed warnings remain visible. No false claim that findings were cleared.
validation.exitReason: Six previously reviewed secret false positives still reported as errors.
